reviews.text: 不只有炮塔的Creeper World 4，挺好玩。 竞速只放到排行榜就可以了。现在研发点非要抢那点时间才给全，对喜欢稳扎稳打的玩家过于不友好了。 一倍速太慢，想要一个默认倍速的设置项。 显示优化差点意思，完全不觉得最高画质的视觉效果配得上我显卡风扇的转速。

Only a few hours in and just about 66% through the campaign and dang, I am just very bored with this. Thus far, it is "a boredom simulator with the illusion of strategy and choice." There is zero strategic experimentation, immersion, or fun stuff here, just a linear cookie-cutter strat against a zerglike creepcluster concept. There are no "options" for your defense or attack. You either follow that linear boring path, or you die. That said, the game was stable, graphically pleasing, auditorily pleasing, UI/UX was decent, and the controls were fantastic, something many EA releases struggle with. However, the gameplay loop was a hard bounce for me. I will definitely revisit the game in the future, but for now let it cook.
Fun weed whacking rts

Really Enjoying this so far, first RTS I felt I was hooked by in years, only thing different that I was they would do is my tech tree was on like the home screen. So as i played like skirmish match or anything I can get more research points to feel like im growing across all my play time. Plus you know I hope the research tree keeps going. Highly recommend and excited to see what comes next.

This game takes me way back to my childhood of red alert. And when my pc broke I used ms paint to make maps and I would imagine this tug of war between a the blue and red brush tool. Its so good. The constant wave of attack and getting over that satisfying tipping point. Really fun. And the end game recap is exactly like my ms paint maps. So satisfying. I also haven't encountered any bugs so far. Highly recommended.

After seeing all the reviews comparing it to Creeper worlds 3, i expected something different. considering the scale of the enemy i expected the game to be a grand strategy where i could build an army and direct them towards the opponent. But, the very simple unit AI combined with Unit stats that are not at all suitable for fighting the Calyx, doing so will accomplish.. nearly nothing at all. Even with a capped army of units you can end up in a stalemate where the Calyx regrows *faster* than your army can destroy it, and is actively hurting your units all the while. Instead; It's a microfest where you'll need to tell your unit where to target every single second to make any notable progress. Besides that, the further the enemy spreads, the stronger it gets, so the first thing you need to do every mission isn't to build up your economy, it's to bumrush power connectors and defensive towers and minimize the area the Calyx can spread to lest you get punished with a harder mission, which feels awful. This isn't helped by the fact that *every* mission is a time-trial, where if you're too slow to reach certain objectives and/or finish the overall mission too slowly, you end up with less research points, making future missions even harder. Frankly, I hate timed objectives. You have an upgrade tree with upgrades that are.. difficult to judge. I can get an upgrade that says 'Increases explosive damage', but nowhere in game can i see what deals explosive damage; I guess we're supposed to guess from the unit fx? An upgrade said it'd enable 'Orbital Weapons' and instead i got the ability to.. drop harvesters/workers from orbit? Upgrades can't be refunded so i'm stick with several upgrades i consider entirely useless unless i restart my save. in short, I don't find the very limited playstyle that the game enforces to be any fun.

[quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/laoshirenLSR]老实人评测[/url]：独立游戏爱好者聚集地，黄油绅士交流中心。 不错过游戏的亮点，不放过游戏的槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote] [h1]《星萼》：异星之上的科幻基建RTS[/h1] 《星萼》是一款来自独立制作组Studio 568的上帝视角3D基地建设策略战术模拟游戏，其实说的简单一点，就是RTS游戏。而在这款看上去像是基建模拟游戏的作品中，你需要在外星环境下建造矿场、生产地面作战部队，并且清缴一种占据地表的藤蔓类类植物外星生物“星萼”，避免其妨碍你为公司采矿。 单论玩法的话，本作完全就是一款传统意义上的RTS游戏，玩家需要基建、生产作战单位，然后操控作战单位进行巡逻与战斗。但是和传统的以消灭敌人为主要目标的RTS相比，本作还是更多地将玩家重心放在了“基建”这一部分之上。玩家在游戏中的主要目标并非完全依靠“消灭敌人”作为核心动力来驱动，而是将传统RTS中“收集资源”这一阶段的内容作为了游戏在设定上的核心目标。 因此简单来说，就是本作和同类游戏相比，虽然同样是战术模拟游戏，但是其战斗压力更小、操作更加轻松简便，而且除了游戏中后期的与动态敌人作战以外，很多时候玩家操作的地面部队需要参与的主要战斗就只清除场景中蔓延的藤蔓，颇有一种“清洁工模拟器”类游戏的即视感，不仅没有生存压力，还相当解压。当然，随着游戏流程推进，玩家需要面对的外星生物类型和敌人情况将会越来越复杂，通过序章以后的“星萼”甚至还会逐渐扩张繁殖，相当于是会逐步增加玩家的战斗挑战来增加挑战和游戏性。 而且和传统的RTS不一样，本作虽然是以基建为主的游戏，但却在战术指挥系统上进行了一定的创新，玩家可以通过双击单个单位来选中全部作战单位，并且在选中全部作战单位的期间，玩家可以通过单纯拖动鼠标右键来让部队全部单位均匀分布——换句话说，你可以通过鼠标右键来让你手下的坦克们以任意“长度”和“位置”来排列成一条会自动作战的直线，相当于是快捷布置一条战术防线，而且这条防线还可以通过右键画出一条新直线来快速推进。 总结来说，《星萼》是一款以RTS玩法来进行操作的策略基建模拟游戏，游戏以基地建设为主，着重资源管理，而非战术模拟。因此虽然游戏可能因为不够硬核而无法吸引到部分核心RTS游戏的玩家，但对于这类作品的入门爱好者来说，本作操作简单、玩法易懂，虽然富有挑战，但又没有过高的生存压力，不失解压与休闲性。

防御塔便宜但是耗电，单位不耗电但是太贵，科技太贵，玩起来很卡手。电池也很贵，意义不明。以为会有ai盟友了，结果戛然而止。目前游戏流程相比于价格而言远不及亿万僵尸，画质也照样不及亿万僵尸，玩法深度更是莫得。太阳能电池板升级后也才19，各种减少费用科技等扣得要死，只有10%，也就电线杆范围科技最大方，两个都是21%范围，而我方炮车没有升级射程的科技，只能跟对面的防御塔对掏或者在前边让小坦克走位拉火力。游戏整体下来负面体验很多，正面强化很少，然而关卡全都限制时间给科技点，这游戏只有开最低难度还能勉强觉得爽，但凡是中等难度就很坐牢了。
流星和迫击炮的射程可以略微提高，炼狱的血量有些低，敌对坦克的每波次敌人数增长是否有些快？ 需要无尽模式

It has been years since I've seen a RTS game that actually looks unique. This might look similar to Creeper World but it is incredibly different as you control units and the enemies get stronger and upgrade as time goes on! This is definitely not near completion though. For RTS games I basically exclusively play skirmish modes, and on this game the maps are just incredibly too tiny with no "tech levels" that you see in most RTS games that I believe should belong here. Instead you select the "tech level" at the start of the game and then research whichever units you want, meaning you can use only the starter units and then research the most expensive unit skipping everything in between (which is what I did). If maps get expanded largely and tech levels added, I would recommend everyone to try this, but as for now, only try if you're a RTS enthusiast looking for something new.

我不推荐这个游戏， 先说游戏的优点吧？感觉bug不多，游戏优化很好。画面很不错。音乐尤其棒。技术上做的很好，多炮塔，弹道。 缺点也很明显： 1.游戏模式过于单一，玩过十个小时之后就觉得非常无聊了。 2.单位缺乏多样性，只有陆军6个单位，虽然是个采矿公司， 3.故事剧情类似阿凡达，这游戏里竟然没有空军，也没有敌对单位，比如没有虫子，感觉还不如玩命令与征服2打泰伯利亚藤蔓。 4.单位的机设巨丑。对。巨丑。 5.基本没有地形 6.这游戏完全不值92这个价格。最多值30块钱。我要不是游玩超时了。我一定退货。 7.鉴于制作者可能自己也觉得玩时间长了太无聊。给游戏设了加速按钮，这值得称赞。

已通关，感觉当前版本还是不建议购买 唯一的优点就是星萼的设定了，但是发挥的也很有限 UI丑陋，自动寻路做的较差配上CNC一样的慢速转身就更难受了，视角快捷键操控很别扭，平衡问题也很大，内容丰富度也欠缺，希望后续能坚持更新吧。 另；当前版本战役很多关卡可以基地泰山压顶/电线杆延伸+防御塔来tower rush逃课，普通星萼、召唤星萼和紫色远程星萼都可以直接用这个方法开局rush掉，绿色的星萼需要额外有个t2的坦克A星萼前面的地板，溅射伤害也能给它无伤带走。 目前版本仇恨做的很简单，外加全图建造的设定也大大降低了难度，冲对面塔阵/紫色星萼/堡垒星萼的时候可以多放10元墙，如果对面塔数量少弹道速度慢你甚至可以在出弹道动画后把建造的塔取消，无损吸引炮火。

The game is clearly inspired by Creeper World 4 and I appreciate that. The beginning was fun and challenging, but the fun didnt hold on for long. The game loop is very much the same: -Dont get overrun by enemies -Build defenses to maintain for the beginning -Build economy -Upgrade everything and build vehicles -Kill 'em. That's pretty much it. There were instances where this wasnt the case, but this is the normal game loop. It is boring, uninnovative and stale. I would have loved for some air units, but nope. Neither can you air drop vehicles on montains, nor do you have the ability to use "hidden" paths on the map for some interesting strategies. and whats even the point on using air drops? That function is super expensive? Vehicles are expensive, buildings are expensive and upgrades are expensive. Before reaching the few levels you were limited to the ressources you have...
令人惊讶的是，该游戏中不仅有不少创新，比如技能点的收集点亮，再比如防守和进攻结合巧妙，令激烈战争和悄然发展相得益彰，还有很多复古元素，比如建造基地很难不让你回忆起老朋友C&C，而单位模型也颇有一些横扫千军的身影，叠加在一起，就是本作的综合体验：稳健防守+反击扫图，希望开发组不断更新，继续提升可玩性。

基本就是靠开局用供电塔偷跑，只要尽可能遏制或是击杀就稳赢 玩起来还不错，就是不知道为什么总感觉缺点什么，期待后续有更多好玩的更新 新更新的海军可玩性有点低了，海军地图其实靠的还是防御塔和墙来的，主要就是用墙包围（最好加点防御塔，有些虫子会就近攻击）整个生产建筑，这样虫子就会绕路去攻打基地，基地那要留口子给虫子走，然后口子周边多建防御塔来杀虫子，类似有缺口的瓮城 海军单位确实比较鸡肋了，就是建造出来完成任务或者运兵用的。远处的敌人可以用激光点杀，也可以用空投派陆地单位。

I Absolutely Love this game! If you're a Fan of oldskl C&C or Creeper World... You'll Love this game!!!! I've just purchased the game and played the first 5-6 levels, but to be crystal-clear, I was previously providing feedback within the "Play-tests" that I signed upto, pre-Early Access launch! This is why i've waited a while to see what the launch intaled and now i've dived in. So my feedback here, maybe a tad-squewed, as I was already familiar with most of the game mechanics etc due to being a "Play-Tester"... That being said... This game Continues to be Amazing! I waited awhile after the launch before buying & playing it... It seems the EA release has had an update or two... So I bit the bullet and made my purchase and at the time of this review: I've played through the first 5-6 levels! This game Sooo Reminds me of the old-skl C&C:Tiberiun Sun days... PVE-RTS @ It's finest if you ask me! This game is like a mating of(cross between) My two Ultimate RTS favourites: 'Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun' & 'Creeper World' I for one Love it! -=-=-=-=-=-=- To the Devs: I Thank you for not using any A.I to voice the campaign storyline! Personally I prefer reading text, than having an A.I voice over... So Thank you for NOT jumping on the disliked/hated A.I bandwagon! That being said, I think you'll get much more engagement if you can afford to hire a couple of real Voice actors to provide you with Voice-Over for the Campaign storyline. If you're waiting until the game is at v1.0, before doing so... that is also understandable, as highering real VO ppl is expensive. Ultimately I give this game a 9/10 in It's current state... Adding real (human Voiced) VO for the Campaign messages, would push it upto a 10/10! Imo! Fore anyone who enjoys PVE-RTS... You'll Love this game!

Love the game concept and the aesthetics but one glaring issue exists. The balance is whack when it comes to the Artillery Calyx. On mission 5 you already get 2 of them on the map and they just destroy any tanks in like 2~3 shots on normal difficulty. Even the bulky tank. At this point you basically have no effective way of repairing and the only repair option essentially repairs so slow you'd be better off replacing the entire unit. They evolve too fast and deal too much damage and outrange any turret (makes sense, if not for how strong they are vs all your tanks and how fast they shoot). By 10 minutes in they are already max level with dozens of almost unapproachable artillery growths which is intensified in difficulty due to the growth speed of the creep of of a level 3 Calyx. Will ammend my review when this gets addressed.

以前的版本是好游戏可以前期用各种战术也可以后期巨型单位爽割草。最近新出的海军版本敌升我降自己方不加强不说还削弱，敌方到是感觉是所有植物的加强结合体，节点能放鱼雷，能出超硬小虫子基地满改旁边穿过去一只都打不掉的那种，小虫子还能无视防御塔去直接偷后面的建筑……科技树新页面一个海军升级也没有，感觉海军是脑洞大开突然硬加的一样，新页面解锁的大激光车在新版本也很鸡肋一炮打一只海军小虫子一截血只能最后打其他岛用一下，基本强制全面防御拖入后期，后期也是强行换血，感觉毫无诚意的版本！具体就是海军单位几个又弱又贵又鸡肋，毫无科技升级还不得不出，战列舰主炮副炮打小虫子都是挠痒痒打基地射程没有别人远强行换血感觉还没壁垒（陆地小坦克）好用，海军加血只能加一个还很慢射程很短，小机关枪船好像威力挺好的但是其实也是炮灰单位只能换血，对了，海军还没有防御塔，完全没陆战的爽了打无语了，希望制作组能改一下

Definitely a great RTS Tower Defense Builder. I thought for sure I was not going to like the fact that it gives you different levels to work with and not a persistent open world survival type approach, but the levels are actually well thought out and just as strategic as Factorio, (even more so due to the overwhelming growth of Calyx, rather than the wave approach from Factorio. I would eventually love to see a persistent open-world design where there is "Alpha Calyx" plants on the corners of the map that you cannot eliminate, but you CAN contain if you have the means to do so. It would obviously mean that each alpha Calyx can only grow so far, but spawn the newer spawn calyx that CAN be eliminated. Kinda like a domino effect, or rather, the MOBA base design where you have to go through smaller bases to get to the main base. Definitely recommend this game if you're a fan of RTS, Tower Defense, Strategy Builders, or similar(ish) games like Factorio, the Rift Breaker, etc.

So far it's 9/10

Its a fun little game. Building up your forces to slowly push back against the Calyx is quite fun. The missions do get repetitive but you can get about 20 hours out of it easily. Or a lot more if you like to replay missions on harder difficulties. And there are more missions to come as well becuase the campaign is not finished yet. It has tower defence elements in the early game and then you slowly build up and tech up and go on the offensive. What I really loved is the unit formations. In other RTS, units just blob up randomly. Here, you automatically get short range units in the front, followed by artillery and then repair units in nice little formations. More RTSs should implement this. I played just after the Leviathan update when the game was quite hard. But some people were whining about not being able to build on beaches etc. so they just released a patch which made the game easier. I dont think it was needed as I managed to finish every mission except one in my first attempt. I can see myself going back to it to finish the campaign when they add those last missions.

It feels like it downgrades each time I come back to play... Upgrade system is now a tedium and quite poor, yet plays a large part in the game (or it should but not upgrading and just rushing more of everything seems to work better now). Any semblance of upgrades for range in units or defences seemed to have disappeared whilst my enemy continued to have what seemed like 'true' upgraded turrets, making for a very one sided game of attrition with their limitless spam. Artillery are still pathetic, even more with the upgrades as they are now. I don't understand the direction intended. EDIT: The upgrade tree just ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ sucks, meager barely improved stat boosts occasionally with tech upgrades and units that require wasting resources going into the research buildings. I feel like I'm playing a different version to everyone else at this point; most of the game is better just blitzed with basic first two units and maybe an extra or so for situational reasons. Hell, dropping the base on top of an enemy spawn is likely one of the most viable and maybe even recommended tactics just to cleave out a chunk of enemy resistance, before it's a problem. Your units are largely awful, your defences are pitiful, the research is tedium both in map and on the larger tech tree.... why bother writing more?
